description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingView component of the application, verifying UI assembly, page flow logic, and behavior of remote gateway selection.

classes.name: OnboardingViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases for the onboarding view component.

methods.name: `onboarding view builds body`
methods.description: Verifies that the onboarding view's body property can be built without errors.

methods.name: `page order omits workspace and identity steps`
methods.description: Checks that certain steps are omitted or included in the onboarding page sequence based on provided parameters.

methods.name: `page order omits onboarding chat when identity known`
methods.description: Ensures the onboarding chat page is omitted when the user's identity is recognized.

methods.name: `select remote gateway clears stale ssh target when endpoint unresolved`
methods.description: Tests that selecting a remote gateway correctly clears the remote target string if the endpoint is unresolved.
